title: moma-ac: a preference-driven actor-critic framework for continuous multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning
core_idea: Introduce MOMA-AC, an inner-loop, preference-driven actor–critic framework for continuous-state and continuous-action multi-objective multi-agent RL. The design combines a multi-headed actor network, a centralized critic, and objective preference-conditioning so that a single neural policy per agent can encode the Pareto front of trade-off policies; the framework is instantiated with TD3 and DDPG.
tldr: A preference-conditioned actor–critic framework (MOMA-AC) for continuous multi-objective multi-agent RL that uses multi-headed actors and a centralized critic to represent Pareto-optimal trade-offs within single neural policies; includes TD3/DDPG instantiations and a proposed continuous MOMARL test suite.
